source_locator: 2011-2013 section, Run Off Election Saturday June 18, 2011, Place No. 15 (Mayor); resolution 11-1900
verification_note: On May 14, 2011 a first round was held (Rawlings 28,424; Kunkle 22,229; Natinsky 17,430; Okpa 1,474) with no majority, so the June 18, 2011 runoff decided the office. Runoff totals Rawlings 31,088 and Kunkle 24,623. The first round is not recorded as a separate election. Leppert resigned February 25, 2011; the election followed the regular four-year mayoral cycle (2007, 2011, 2015, 2019, 2023). Source is the Dallas City Secretary History of Mayors and City Councils, which lists the council canvass resolution number for the election.

source_locator: 2015-2017 section, Election Saturday May 9, 2015, Place No. 15 (Mayor); resolution 15-0905
verification_note: Nonpartisan general election with a majority winner; no mayoral runoff (June 13, 2015 runoff covered places 3, 7, 8, 10 only). Rawlings 30,692; Ronquillo 11,383; write-in Richard P. Sheridan 63. Source is the Dallas City Secretary History of Mayors and City Councils, which lists the council canvass resolution number for the election.

source_locator: 2019-2021 section, Run Off Election Saturday June 8, 2019, Mayor/Place No. 15; resolution 19-0955
verification_note: May 4, 2019 first round had no majority (Johnson 16,402; Griggs 14,921; nine others). The June 8, 2019 runoff decided the office: Johnson 41,247; Griggs 32,918. The first round is not recorded separately. Press totals differ slightly (41,208 and 32,898); the City Secretary figures are used. Source is the Dallas City Secretary History of Mayors and City Councils, which lists the council canvass resolution number for the election.

source_locator: 2023-2025 section, Election Saturday May 6, 2023, Mayor/Place No. 15; resolution 23-0665
verification_note: Incumbent Johnson was the only candidate on the ballot and received 43,028 votes. The official document lists an aggregate Write-In line of 3,227 votes with no named write-in candidate, so no runner-up is recorded and the election is treated as uncontested. Source is the Dallas City Secretary History of Mayors and City Councils, which lists the council canvass resolution number for the election.
